## Verdict: APPROVED ? one required ledger action, no code findings

### The exclusion is generated build output, verified four ways

- `.gitignore:10` ignores `/.next/`; `git ls-files .next` returns **0 tracked files**.
- Contents are Next.js build artifacts: `BUILD_ID`, `*-manifest.json`, `server/`, `static/`, `cache/`, `types/`.
- `.next/types/app/**/route.ts` are generated wrappers that `import * as entry from '../../../../../../src/app/.../route.js'` ? the real source is in `src/`, which is exactly why coverage-v8 choked remapping them.
- Decisive check on the fresh `coverage-final.json`: **91 files instrumented, 0 from `.next`, 87 from `src/`** ? including all 14 `src/app/api` routes and 34 `src/components` files. Nothing production-side was dropped.

### The crash claim reproduces, and the fix is attributable

Differential control, identical flags minus the one new entry:

```
--coverage.exclude (original five, no .next/**):
  Tests 40 passed, then:
  TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')
    at buildBySources  @vitest/coverage-v8/dist/provider.js:1051
    at generatedPosition ... originalEndPositionFor ... _maybeRemapStartColEndCol
  exit 1
```

With `.next/**` in place, `check.mjs suite` ? `Verified 40 passing tests from a fresh report.` / `P00_SUITE_VERIFIED`, exit 0. One line, `1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)`.

### Gates run fresh this session

| Gate | Marker | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| `check.mjs suite` | `P00_SUITE_VERIFIED` (40 tests) | 0 |
| `check.mjs cron` | `P00_CRON_VERIFIED` (18 tests) | 0 |
| `check.mjs types` | `P00_TYPES_VERIFIED` | 0 |
| `check.mjs lint` | `P00_LINT_VERIFIED` | 0 |

`check.mjs lint` includes `vitest.config.ts` in its file list, so the changed file is covered by its own gate. HOOK-GATES.md: `ALL MET (3 met)` ? the `CWD: ../../../..` correction is applied to G1 and G2 and the runner recorded real evidence for both. Search source and test are byte-identical to what I approved (`f26e9f09?`, `f2ff7852?`), committed as `223555c`, and are not part of this diff.

### F9 ? GATES.md G2 is still recorded unmet

```
gate-check --status GATES.md  ->  UNMET: 1 (met: 6)
                                    GATES:G2 (unchecked)
```

`GATES.md:10-14` has G2 as `- [ ]` with `EVIDENCE: pending` ? gate-check demoted it when the coverage crash made it fail, and it has not been re-run since the config fix. The fix genuinely works (I just ran that exact CHECK, exit 0, marker matched), but as it stands this commit ships with its own gate marked unmet. One command closes it: run gate-check on `GATES.md` so G2 gets real recorded evidence rather than my transcript.

### Optional, non-blocking

The root cause is that `coverage.all` defaults on and scans the whole project root, so any generated directory that appears later (`out/`, `.turbo/`, a second build dir) re-breaks this the same way. `include: ['src/**']` is the same one line and removes the class of problem instead of the instance. Your current fix is verified and minimal, so this is a preference, not a finding.
